summary: All formulas match calculation-rules.md exactly, transactions are safe, no AI/ML language found, all 77 tests pass; two non-blocking issues noted: requirements.md AC-05-4 error message wording diverges from implementation, and the frontend Vitest suite is missing the calcTrendWarning(add3>0, add7=0) edge case.
findings: Error message wording mismatch: requirements.md AC-05-4 specifies 'current stock: N' but the implementation and design.md both emit 'current: N'. Tests pass against the implementation. Update requirements.md to match or change the implementation — they must agree.
Frontend Vitest suite does not cover calcTrendWarning when add7=0 and add3>0 (returns true). Backend covers this case. Add the missing test to frontend/src/utils/inventory.test.ts.
